name: findcheap-agent
description: Search Shopify Global Catalog and an approved Awin Feed, find verified deals, and monitor prices, promotions, and stock.

interface.shortDescription: Verified cards, pricing, coupons, and safe links.
interface.longDescription: FindCheap Agent is a Codex Plugin Agent. v0.8.2 exposes one product-search entrypoint across configured product sources plus an authorized zero-result Chrome fallback. Commercial relationships never affect relevance or ranking. All qualifying products use one Codex-native card contract with explicit identity, condition, merchant trust, and price scope. Selected-product follow-ups reuse the exact prior renderId and stable product identity; supported merchant pages can resolve to Shopify Cart for shipping, tax, and estimated-total quotes. Watch rules bind to native Codex Automation and distinguish item price from estimated delivered total. The agent never checks out, reserves inventory, purchases, or pays.
defaultPrompt: Search products, find verified deals, or create and bind a Watch to Codex Automation. Never launch MCP.
